glosses.notes: Used to say something is worth doing or deserves the time, money, or effort.

example_translations.translation: This book is well worth reading.
This matter is worth thinking about carefully.
This place is worth coming back to.

glosses.notes: Refers to the employees or workers of a factory, company, or work unit.

example_translations.translation: Factory staff all go to work on time.
The company staff are in a meeting.
The new worker is very young.

glosses.notes: The regular work or profession that someone does for a living.

example_translations.translation: What is your occupation?
He wants to change to a different profession.
Being a doctor is her profession.

glosses.notes: Shows that someone has no better option and must do something.

examples.sentence: 外面下雨了，我们只好坐车去。
时间不早了，我只好先回家。
他忘了带钱，只好找朋友帮忙。

example_translations.translation: It is raining outside, so we have to go by car.
It is getting late, so I have to go home first.
He forgot to bring money, so he has no choice but to ask a friend for help.

glosses.notes: Used to limit what is being said, often meaning only or merely.

examples.sentence: 我只是想问你一个问题。

example_translations.translation: I only want to ask you one question.
He just looks happy.
This is merely a beginning.

glosses.notes: Can mean only, or introduce the condition only if.

examples.sentence: 只有认真准备，才会成功。

example_translations.translation: There is only one empty seat here.
Only by preparing carefully can you succeed.
He only has time on weekends.

glosses.notes: Used as a verb meaning to point to, refer to, or indicate something.

examples.sentence: 老师指着地图上的北京说：“这是首都。”
这个数字指今年的结果。

example_translations.translation: Pointing at Beijing on the map, the teacher said, "This is the capital."
The teacher talks while pointing at the blackboard.
This number indicates this year's result.

glosses.notes: Means to clearly identify, mention, or indicate something for others.

examples.sentence: 他先指出原因，再说办法。
新闻里指出了这个变化。

example_translations.translation: The teacher pointed out my problem.
He first points out the cause, then talks about a solution.
The news report pointed out this change.

glosses.notes: Means to guide someone or give direction in work, study, or an activity.

examples.sentence: 老师指导我们准备比赛。

example_translations.translation: The teacher is guiding us in preparing for the competition.
The manager is guiding the new staff.
This book can guide your study.

glosses.notes: Shows that a situation has continued up to now.

example_translations.translation: This matter is still unresolved.
He still remembers that sentence to this day.
We still haven't seen each other.

glosses.notes: Shows the minimum amount, number, or degree.

examples.sentence: 这本书我至少看了两遍。

example_translations.translation: This trip will take at least three days.
You should at least tell me.
I have read this book at least twice.

glosses.notes: Often refers to a person’s ideal, wish, or hoped-for future goal.

examples.sentence: 我小时候的志愿是当老师。
他的志愿一直没有改变。

example_translations.translation: Her aspiration is to become a doctor.
My childhood wish was to become a teacher.
His aspiration has never changed.

glosses.notes: A person who helps willingly without being forced to do so.

examples.sentence: 周末有很多志愿者来帮忙。
她现在是医院的志愿者。
志愿者正在门口等大家。

example_translations.translation: Many volunteers come to help on weekends.
She is now a volunteer at the hospital.
The volunteers are waiting for everyone at the door.

glosses.notes: Means to make and set out a plan, policy, or rule in a formal way.

examples.sentence: 公司正在制定发展目标。

example_translations.translation: The school formulated a new set of rules.
Let us first draw up a plan.
The company is formulating development goals.

glosses.notes: Refers to an organized system or a set of rules that people follow.

examples.sentence: 公司有自己的管理制度。

example_translations.translation: This system has already been changed.
The new rules are fairer to everyone.
The company has its own management system.

glosses.notes: Means to make goods in a factory, or create something such as trouble or noise.

examples.sentence: 坏天气制造了不少麻烦。

example_translations.translation: This factory manufactures cars.
The bad weather created quite a bit of trouble.
Do not make too much noise.

glosses.notes: Used for making or producing something such as food, programs, or materials.

example_translations.translation: He is making a card.
This program is very well produced.
Let us make the poster together.

glosses.notes: Refers to the middle area of a place, country, or object.

example_translations.translation: There are many cities in central China.
The central part of this country gets a lot of rain.
There is still a little snow on the middle part of the mountain.

glosses.notes: Refers to the Chinese nation as a people with a shared history and culture.

examples.sentence: 我们学习中华民族文化。
这本书写中华民族故事。

example_translations.translation: The Chinese nation loves peace.
We study Chinese national culture.
This book tells stories of the Chinese nation.

glosses.notes: Shows that something happened at last after waiting or difficulty.

example_translations.translation: We finally got home.
He finally found a job.
It rained all day and finally stopped.

glosses.notes: Can refer to a clock, a bell, or the clock-hour in time expressions.

examples.sentence: 下课钟一响，大家就出来了。

example_translations.translation: The clock on the wall is five minutes slow.
As soon as the class bell rang, everyone came out.
It is already ten o’clock now.

glosses.notes: A measure or noun meaning a kind, type, or category of thing.

example_translations.translation: This kind of method is relatively simple.
I want to buy that kind of fruit.
This place has many kinds of flowers.

glosses.notes: The small part of a plant that can grow into a new plant.

examples.sentence: 春天到了，我们去买种子。

example_translations.translation: Spring is here, so we are going to buy seeds.
These seeds can be planted tomorrow.
There are many flower seeds on the ground.

glosses.notes: Describes something very important or serious in size or influence.

example_translations.translation: This is a major decision.
A significant change happened at the company.
This matter has a major impact.

glosses.notes: Refers to the area around something or the people and things nearby.

example_translations.translation: There are many small shops around the school.
He looked at the people around him.
Many trees were planted around the house.

glosses.notes: The common word for a pig.

example_translations.translation: This pig eats a lot.
I saw a pig on television.
The little pig follows its mother.

glosses.notes: Means to host a program, activity, or meeting, or preside over it.

example_translations.translation: She is hosting this program today.
The teacher asked him to preside over the meeting.
It is his first time hosting an event.

glosses.notes: Describes acting on one’s own initiative instead of waiting to be told.

example_translations.translation: He took the initiative to help me move things.
She took the initiative to speak to the teacher.
If there is a problem, you should ask on your own initiative.

glosses.notes: A title for the person in charge of a department, office, or school section.

example_translations.translation: The director is not here today.
The school director came to inspect the work.
He wants to see the director for a moment.

glosses.notes: An idea or plan that someone has in mind.

examples.sentence: 这个主意是谁想出来的？

example_translations.translation: This idea of yours is really good.
I still have not thought of a good idea.
Who came up with this idea?

glosses.notes: Can mean a viewpoint or claim, and it can also be a verb meaning to advocate.

example_translations.translation: I do not agree with his view.
She has opinions of her own.
The teacher advocates that everyone practice more.

glosses.notes: Means to notice something carefully or be careful about it.

example_translations.translation: Be careful about safety when crossing the road.
The teacher told me to pay attention to this character.
Please pay attention to the notice at the entrance.

glosses.notes: Used to express good wishes to someone.

example_translations.translation: I wish you a happy birthday.
Everyone wishes him a safe trip.
I wish you success in the competition.

glosses.notes: Means to catch, seize, or hold something quickly.

example_translations.translation: The police quickly caught the bad guy.
He went to grab the ball.
She held onto the doorknob and did not let go.

glosses.notes: Means to hold something firmly, or figuratively seize a chance.

example_translations.translation: Please grab hold of my hand.
Everyone seized the opportunity.
He grabbed hold of my hand.

glosses.notes: A person with deep knowledge or skill in a field.

example_translations.translation: You need to ask an expert about this question.
The doctor said it would be best to invite a specialist.
He is an expert on this issue.

glosses.notes: Often means especially or specially; in some contexts it can describe specializing in something.

example_translations.translation: I came especially to see you today.
This shop specializes in selling books.
The teacher came especially to help me.

glosses.notes: A specific topic or special feature treated in a focused way.

examples.sentence: 我们下周讨论这个专题。

example_translations.translation: The teacher is talking about this special topic today.
The TV station made a special feature.
We will discuss this topic next week.

glosses.notes: Can mean a field of study, an area of specialty, or professional in quality.

example_translations.translation: She studies Chinese as her major at university.
This question is very specialized.
He likes his major very much.

glosses.notes: Means to turn around or revolve.

example_translations.translation: That ball keeps spinning.
The earth turns every day.
This ball is spinning very fast.

glosses.notes: Refers to a shift or transformation in ideas, situation, or way of life.

examples.sentence: 他的想法有了很大转变。
公司这几年发生了转变。
她想转变自己的生活方式。

example_translations.translation: His thinking has undergone a big change.
The company has changed over these past few years.
She wants to change her way of life.

glosses.notes: Refers to the condition or situation of a person, thing, or event.

examples.sentence: 现在公司的状况更好了。

example_translations.translation: His physical condition is good.
The company’s situation is better now.
First take a look at the situation here.

glosses.notes: Refers to the current state or condition of a person, thing, or process.

examples.sentence: 机器现在还是工作状态。

example_translations.translation: I'm in a great mood for studying today.
The machine is still in working condition now.
Her mental state has been good recently.

glosses.notes: Means to run after or pursue someone or something.

example_translations.translation: That dog has been chasing the cat.
He runs fast, and others cannot catch up with him.
I do not want to keep chasing this car.

glosses.notes: Can mean accurate or on time, and in some contexts means to permit.

example_translations.translation: Your watch keeps very accurate time.
What he said was very accurate.
You are not allowed to go out today.

glosses.notes: Refers to the qualifications or eligibility needed for something.

examples.sentence: 他没有参加比赛的资格。
这份工作要求很高的资格。
只有老师才有这个资格吗？

example_translations.translation: He is not qualified to take part in the competition.
This job requires high qualifications.
Are only teachers eligible for this?

glosses.notes: Money set aside for a project, business, or specific use.

examples.sentence: 公司把资金用在教育上。

example_translations.translation: The company has no funds right now.
The company used its funds for education.
The company needs capital now.

glosses.notes: A formal word for one’s children, especially sons and daughters together.

examples.sentence: 他们的子女都在外地工作。
她一个人照顾两个子女。

example_translations.translation: Their children all work away from home.
They care a great deal about their children.
She takes care of two children by herself.

glosses.notes: Introduces the starting point in time from which something continues.

examples.sentence: 自从搬家以后，他更忙了。
我自从来这里就很开心。
自从那次见面以后，我们常联系。

example_translations.translation: Since moving house, he has become busier.
I have been very happy since coming here.
Since that meeting, we have stayed in touch often.

glosses.notes: Describes something that operates by itself without direct control.

examples.sentence: 机器到了时间会自动停。

example_translations.translation: This door opens automatically.
He switched the car to automatic mode.
The machine will stop automatically when the time comes.

glosses.notes: Describes acting consciously and on one’s own initiative.

example_translations.translation: He can finish his homework on his own initiative.
Everyone should line up and get on the bus of their own accord.
She turned off the light on her own.

glosses.notes: Can describe what is natural in style or what belongs to nature.

example_translations.translation: She smiled very naturally.
The natural environment here is very good.
He speaks more and more naturally.

glosses.notes: Refers to a person or thing itself, especially in relation to its own condition.

examples.sentence: 公司也在检查自身问题。

example_translations.translation: We need to change ourselves first.
This matter is related to his own situation.
The company is also examining its own problems.

glosses.notes: Describes doing something independently and on one’s own initiative.

example_translations.translation: Children need to learn to study independently.
She wants to arrange her time on her own.
Children need to make decisions on their own.

glosses.notes: Often used in spoken Chinese as a shorter form meaning always.

example_translations.translation: He always says he is not tired.
I always feel that something is wrong about this matter.
He always arrives a little earlier than I do.

glosses.notes: Means to sum up the main points, and it can also mean a summary as a noun.

examples.sentence: 老师让我们总结今天的内容。
开会以后，经理总结了问题。

example_translations.translation: The teacher asked us to summarize today’s content.
He made a brief summary.
After the meeting, the manager summarized the problems.

glosses.notes: Used to say that something happens all the time or repeatedly.

example_translations.translation: He always arrives very late.
Mom always gets up very early.
He always arrives very early.

glosses.notes: Describes an amount that is enough or sufficient for a need.

example_translations.translation: This is enough money already.
There are enough seats here.
You do not have enough time to prepare.

glosses.notes: The game of soccer, also called football in many places.

example_translations.translation: Many people like soccer.
My younger brother likes watching football best.
We are watching a soccer match this afternoon.

glosses.notes: Can mean a combination or group, and also combining things together.

examples.sentence: 这两种方法可以组合使用。

example_translations.translation: This color combination looks good.
They are a new group.
These two methods can be used in combination.

glosses.notes: Often means around or about an amount or time; literally it can also mean left and right.

examples.sentence: 我们左右看了看才过马路。

example_translations.translation: He arrived at around three in the afternoon.
This bag costs about one hundred yuan.
We looked left and right before crossing the road.

glosses.notes: A literary, artistic, or creative work produced by someone.

example_translations.translation: This is his new work.
That author has many works.
This work is very well known.

glosses.notes: The person who writes a book, article, or other work.

examples.sentence: 作者在书里写了自己的经历。

example_translations.translation: The author of this book is very young.
I want to meet that author.
The author wrote about his own experiences in the book.

glosses.notes: Means to visit someone’s home and be their guest.

examples.sentence: 周末我们去朋友家做客。
欢迎你下次来我家做客。
他昨天去老师家做客了。

example_translations.translation: We are going to a friend’s home as guests this weekend.
You are welcome to come to my home as a guest next time.
He went to his teacher’s home as a guest yesterday.
